messages:
mara: FYI team — embargo for the 'Latency at Scale' benchmark/blog lifts tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Need monitoring, press ops, and social ready. Assets + tracker: https://go.redwood.com/launch-assets :wave:

Diane: PR on standby. I9ll own media triage and interviews. Please confirm the headline and approved quote by 09:50 PT.

Sam: Ops checklist posted in the tracker, I9ll run the pre-publish smoke at 09:00 PT. @lin can eng be on-call 09:30-12:00 PT?

Lin: Yep, eng will be watching dashboards 09:30-12:00 PT. If we see >20% latency regression we9ll rollback to quantized variant and open a P0.

press-bot: Publish job scheduled: blog_publish_job#4421 for 10:00 PT (thread 1991234567). Notifying marketing-live and press-surge channels.

Alex: Social ready, holding for final headline. Two variants (short + thread). Also uploaded 1-min explainer vid to assets.

mara: Embargo copy for trackers (paste into doc):

"Embargo lift 10:00 PT. Key messages: Redwood reduced median token latency ~35% on long-context workloads. Runtime improvements rolling out to Hosted & Dedicated today. Full methodology in the benchmark appendix. Reporter Qs: Q: How measured? A: Public harness + internal traces (see appendix). Q: Quality impact? A: No measurable drop in our evals; see section 4."

Diane: Added press contacts and follow-up questions in tracker. I9ll route interview requests.

elaine: Monitoring plan: rotate 30-min checks from 09:45-12:15 PT on marketing-live and press-surge. I9ll take the first slot and pin the checklist.

Sam: Ops checklist snippet for tracker:
- 09:00 PT: pre-publish smoke
- 09:30 PT: eng standby confirmed
- 09:45 PT: monitoring rotation begins
- 10:00 PT: embargo lift, publish job fires
- 10:05 PT: verify blog page + sample generation
- 10:15 PT: check perf dashboards
- 10:30 PT: confirm social posts & press captures
- If regression >20%: rollback + notify press contact

Alex: Short social: "We cut median token latency ~35% for long-context models. Runtime optimizations rolling out today. Read: go.redwood.com/latency" :rocket:

Diane: Please tag any press visibility tickets as P0 with label 'press-visibility'.

mara: Thanks all — I9ll ping 09:50 PT with final headline. Once job runs, monitoring team move to marketing-live and press-surge. :pray:
